en.title: The Stardust Underground Library and the Brass Breath
en.premise: In the underground library where a colossal brass steam engine keeps a soothing heartbeat, the small memories people have forgotten in life arrive as books. A young apprentice librarian, together with a mysterious night‑time visitor versed in astronomy, unravels the star‑laden memories hidden within ancient pages. It is a quiet tale of nights that wash away the sediment of daily bustle with the light of the stars.

zh.title: 星屑地下书库与铜制呼吸
zh.premise: 巨大的铜制蒸汽机在地下书库里敲击着舒适的节拍，遗忘在人生中的细小记忆化作书本送达。年轻的学徒图书管理员与每晚访来的、擅长天文学的神秘客人一起，解开古老页面中沉睡的星辰记忆。这是一段安静的夜晚故事，让人离开日常喧嚣，用星光净化心中堆积的沉淀。
